name: Little Vampire
source: "Little Vampire" is one of the first games by Alice Soft, still under their former label of Champion Soft. Main heroes are the returning characters of the Rance series - Miki and Kentarou. In this game Miki is kidnapped by Dracula and Kentarou is on the quest to save her.
translation: 《Little Vampire》是爱丽丝软件仍以旧名Champion Soft活动时推出的早期作品之一。主角是再次登场的《兰斯》系列角色来水美树与小川健太郎。本作中，美树遭德古拉绑架，健太郎为救她踏上冒险。
